safety_checks_before_every_heavy_run: Check actual Windows C: and D: disk free, not WSL df alone
Check Windows available RAM plus WSL process tree RSS, then reserve room for OS
Record exact ext4.vhdx current Windows host size and measure its growth
Run only one CLI or independent browser grader at a time
Check target task image compressed/unpacked sizes and cached dependencies BEFORE download
Abort if resource reserve could be crossed by worst-case task worktree/image/extraction
Do not widen auto-approvals or disable sandbox to make a task pass
wsl_ext4_growth_warning: Deleting files in WSL filesystem does not necessarily reclaim actual C: space; measure host VHDX after cleanup.
result_stop_conditions: RAM free inadequate for task+OS reserve
image size and extraction footprint unknown relative to free capacity
wall-clock or process tree RSS cap crossed
